title: Glide 4.0.5 — now with maintanace tracker! 🏎️
body:
🔌⛽ Glide now help you track your energy consumption per car profile! — electric, hybrid or petrol — Check the camera-assisted capture!.

 🗓️Get reminders about insurance renewal or upcoming maintanance. 

📊Get your yearly expenses report including insurance, repairs, and fueling. 

💾 New master backup packs your cars, trip's score and your whole energy log small enough to keep in Drive — and to restore from on a new phone.
